mintAuthority.summary: SOFID is natively issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. on Ethereum and Solana, with BitGo Bank & Trust providing Stablecoin-as-a-Service infrastructure. Ethereum issuance uses the ERC1967 UUPS proxy's native MINTER role plus separate DEFAULT_ADMIN, MASTER_MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE controls; Solana issuance uses a live 1-of-2 Token-2022 mint-authority multisig. Both deployments are native issuance routes; no bridge representation is included in Mint Authority.

controls.label: BitGo issuance backend (Stablecoin-as-a-Service for SoFi)
controls.evidence: BitGo Bank & Trust operates mint, burn, custody, and smart-contract management for SOFID on behalf of issuer SoFi Bank; supply is created 1:1 against cash at SoFi's Federal Reserve master account. No permissionless mint route.

controls.label: SOFID DEFAULT_ADMIN (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770993, owner() and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd84519fc7137e55d37674be353379a27a9bd21fe) returned the authored EOA, and eth_getCode returned no bytecode. The contract is AccessControlDefaultAdminRules; owner() returns DEFAULT_ADMIN. Its 86,400-second default-admin transfer delay is not an independent delay on UUPS upgrades or native minter configuration.

controls.label: SOFID MASTER_MINTER_ROLE (EOA)
controls.capDescription: MASTER_MINTER_ROLE can configure or remove native and bridge minters and set their mint and burn limits; it is an authorizer and is not itself a successful caller of the native mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770993, hasRole(MASTER_MINTER_ROLE, 0x06720dec0fa18bb540eea24c7f196c0bd0c26b7a) returned true and eth_getCode returned no bytecode. The verified source makes MASTER_MINTER_ROLE an authorizer for configureMinter/removeMinter and the corresponding bridge-minter functions; it can change native minter limits but is not itself a successful caller of the native mint path. MASTER_MINTER_ROLE = 0x4d722a319ebda03eb1179096607e87f360b089b3919a0d764a65ea950521a6c9.

controls.label: SOFID UPGRADER_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770993, hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x564fd647254ec3e0bd704c463c1d4494307e88b4) returned true and eth_getCode returned no bytecode. UPGRADER_ROLE = 0xcf6f9f892731e14b8859835f2ff35575f447fb501f46243c4eb8bac19e31a050 and can upgrade the UUPS proxy implementation without an independent timelock.

controls.label: SOFID native MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: The native minter is configured with a 500000000000000-base-unit daily mint and burn limit. This EOA cannot raise its own limit; MASTER_MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN, or an implementation upgrade can change the canonical issuance constraints.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 23997691, MinterConfigured set this native minter's daily mint and burn limits to 500000000000000 base units. At block 25747120, MinterLimitUsed recorded this address with isBridge=false, a 1000000-unit mint, and 499999999000000 units remaining. A current eth_call simulation of mint succeeded, and the address returned no bytecode, confirming the direct native MINTER_ROLE EOA.

controls.label: SOFID Solana Token-2022 mint-authority multisig
controls.capDescription: The Token-2022 mint has a live mint authority and no separate token-layer supply ceiling was identified; the 1-of-2 multisig can authorize native issuance.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439738944, the Token-2022 mint APhcqtzE73es3KAGiVksZFMLGwJDiAey5qZKUrQHEHfS had mintAuthority ApCJFZLJa6ZKW5i599AQcsJbRuePvX9f8hLNzC6zq81t. That Token-2022 multisig reported numRequiredSigners=1 and numValidSigners=2, with signers 96D8v5kpP1ZyN5cmwVVVTKsYpUdACe1WcEAFtpMaeqwh and By1mEVWv9ELECbaFTAA5XZKwFSGF8AUXBCHB2QmaZtde. The mint was not paused. Freeze, permanent-delegate, pause/configuration, and metadata authorities are separate holder-control surfaces and are not included here.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770993, the ERC1967 UUPS proxy 0x0CB6d03B...678092E pointed to the verified Stablecoin implementation 0x69edf9fa820df057e493635ed1db6b9e5f8124a0; its EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = EOA 0xd84519fc... (no bytecode confirmed), MASTER_MINTER_ROLE = EOA 0x06720dec... (no bytecode confirmed, hasRole true), and UPGRADER_ROLE = EOA 0x564fd... (no bytecode confirmed, hasRole true). MASTER_MINTER_ROLE configures native minters and their limits but is not itself the native mint caller; the current native MINTER_ROLE EOA 0x0B4a0152...cE6 is cap-limited at 500000000000000 base units per day, with an isBridge=false usage observation. At finalized Solana slot 439738944, the Token-2022 deployment APhcqtz...HfS had a live 1-of-2 mint-authority multisig with the two recorded signers. Both authored deployments are native issuance routes for SoFi Bank, N.A.; no bridge representation or configured bridge machinery was identified. The Ethereum implementation's generic BRIDGE_MINTER code path is not treated as a bridge route without a configured role and representation. Economic-posture fields remain: BitGo-operated issuance and upgrade EOAs can mint or replace mint logic without an independent timelock, SoFi's official materials describe 1:1 backing and recurring independent monthly reports, but those periodic reports do not establish real-time whole-supply reconciliation, and the OCC supervises issuer SoFi Bank, N.A.
